messages:
maria: Quick weekly readout — running numbers showed APAC-gcp-1 burning 28% more GPU-hours than expected for the next 7 days. Network team flagged intermittent socket stalls on the 40Gbps fabric that increase tail latency and cause extra retries. Can we adjust runway and reassign some reserved capacity? :eyes:

raj: Can you paste the current burn proforma? I can simulate moving 2x T4 pools to europe-west to ease the spike.

maria: Paste from the spreadsheet snapshot: 
- APAC-gcp-1: baseline 9.6k GPU-hrs/week -> projected 12.3k (+28%)
- EU-west-2: baseline 7.1k -> projected 6.2k (headroom ~900 hrs)
- US-west: baseline 11.4k -> projected 11.1k
- Suggested short-term: shift 2 nodepools (~320 hrs/day) from APAC-gcp-1 to EU-west-2 for next 5 business days.

ops-bot: Incident digest: APAC fabric intermittent packet drops (2026-06-14 03:12 UTC — 2026-06-14 04:05 UTC). Affected clusters: apac-gcp-1, apac-gcp-2. Alerts: increased connection resets.

kevin: Moving nodepools is fine but watch SLO on inference-latency-prod. If we shift traffic cross-region we'll see 60–120ms added on p99 for some endpoints. Can we route non-latency-critical batch traffic first? :warning:

yun: On the network side I can push a config that pins flows to alternate spine for the affected racks, reduces reordering. It will take ~30m and a rolling restart of the top-of-rack agents (no kube node restarts). That might recover ~60% of the retry noise.

raj: If yun's config gets us 60% back, we may only need one nodepool shift instead of two. I'll run the math.

maria: OK plan proposal: 1) Yun do network pinning now (30m window). 2) Raj simulate reassign of one nodepool to EU-west-2 and report runway delta in 20m. 3) Kevin coordinate routing so we only migrate batch jobs first. 4) If after 60m burn still > +15%, escalate to move a second nodepool.

kevin: I'll tag the traffic groups: 
```
# route non-critical batch to eu-west priority
kubectl annotate svc batch-ingest infra/region-prefer=eu-west-2 --overwrite
```

raj: Simulation result: moving one nodepool frees ~2.7k GPU-hrs/week from APAC (reduces projected to ~9.6k, back to baseline). Cost delta: +$1.8k/week (egress + reserved capacity mismatch) but keeps SLO intact.

maria: Great. Yun, start the pinning. Raj, prepare the nodepool migration plan (exact node names + drain schedule). Kevin, put a canary rule so only batch workers move first. I'll update leadership after the 60m checkpoint. :thumbsup:

yun: Starting pinning rollout now. Will post update when complete.

ops-bot: Change log: net-agent config pushed to racks r12–r15 by yun at 2034123490. No node restarts required.

yun: Pinning completed — observed 48% reduction in socket resets in the next 10m sample.

maria: Nice. Raj, proceed with single nodepool drain plan. Keep drains staggered 15m apart, cordon then drain with graceful-term 300s.

raj: Copy. Plan snippet: 
```
for node in apac-gcp-1-poolA-{1..8}; do
  kubectl cordon $node
  kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=300
  sleep 900 # allow pods to warm on eu-west
done
```

kevin: I'll monitor the latency dashboard and add a temporary fallback policy if p99 > 750ms.

maria: Thanks all. Action items recorded: yun (net pinning) ✅, raj (migrate 1 pool) in progress, kevin (routing + monitors) in progress. We'll reconvene in 60m for final lambda on runway.

kevin: FYI finance note — raj's one-pool move estimated +$1.8k/week; if we keep it longer-term recommend trading to reserved hours in EU to amortize.

maria: Noted. We'll review in the post-action weekly forecast doc. Closing loop here, 60m check in. :lock:
